Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need to lock the cross-func roadmap + RFC review for next week. Who can steward the agenda? Proposing Wed 9:00am PT or Thu 4:00pm PT. Also want a short triage slot. Thoughts?
Tyler Nguyen: Wed 9am PT works for me :thumbsup:
Anika Bose: I'm out Wed morning (timezone 😅). Thu 4pm PT is ok but prefer Tue 11am PT if we can.
Kevin Ortiz: I like rotating the agenda steward monthly. I can take February (or next slot).
Luca Romano: +1 for rotation. If we rotate, can we also rotate decision-log ownership?
Maya Patel: Rotation sounds good. We should also keep meeting to 60m and stick to agenda. Can whoever stewards add owners to each agenda item.
Anika Bose: I can steward if we do Tue 11am PT sometimes. Otherwise I can take the RFC review owner regardless.
Maya Patel: Draft agenda (suggested):
``` 
1) Quick wins (5m)
2) RFC review (20m) - owner: @Anika Bose
3) Roadmap tradeoffs (20m) - owner: @Kevin Ortiz
4) Open triage (10m)
5) Decisions & action items + decision log update (5m) - owner: steward
```
Kevin Ortiz: Add metrics review under roadmap tradeoffs (5m) — @Sam Lee to bring numbers.
Sam Lee: I can do metrics. Do we have a template for decision log entries or just bullet points?
Luca Romano: Use the decision-log doc in /docs/roadmap/decisions (short bullets + link to RFC). Keeps it light.
Maya Patel: Ok — agreed. Can the steward create the invite and add the agenda + links an hour before? calendar-bot: tentative invite created for Wed 9:00am PT — poll: Wed 9am PT / Thu 4pm PT / Tue 11am PT (3 options).
Tyler Nguyen: I voted Wed 9am PT in the poll.
Anika Bose: Voted Tue 11am PT.
Kevin Ortiz: I picked Wed 9am PT (but flexible).
Maya Patel: Looks split. To resolve quickly: if majority for Wed, we'll keep Wed; else steward chooses. @Kevin Ortiz can you finalize by EOD? If no response assume Wed 9am PT.
Kevin Ortiz: I can finalise by EOD. I'll set steward rotation for March to Kevin and Feb to me? (typo) — actually March I'll steward. I'll create invite and add agenda + decision-log owner (Sam flagged for metrics).
Maya Patel: Thanks. Small ask: when you create invite, please paste RFC links and add reviewers (prod + eng leads). Also pin the decision-log doc.
Kevin Ortiz: Will do. Assigning action: Kevin -> create invite + agenda. Anika -> RFC owner. Sam -> metrics. Luca -> decision-log guideline.
Maya Patel: Great. Ping me if any blockers. :rocket:
